title: The Lion's Spirit Lives On - How to Earn & Missable Status (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: The Lion's Spirit Lives On trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and rarity once the list is public.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A hidden boss tied to the Memory Flower count, which is why flower collection is not optional on a completionist run.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
